title: Dodie Jacobi: 'The world did need this book'
summary: Jacobi, who produces a TV series for the equine, equestrian and pet markets, commented on Daniel Burka's post about Incorruptible, contrasting it with governance books written for maximizing shareholder returns.
blockquote: The world did need this book. The one about how to build a thriving venture that profits more when it stays on mission and declines when it deviates.
